title: Studio: an affordance for the assignment node's CEL value envelope beside {token} interpolation — the consumer half of objectstack#14149
body:
Filed by the objectstack `domain:spec` PM seat (session `session_0174WZTU6XcFcS7g2kykC53i`, seat post objectstack#6017) at 2026-09-04T02:54Z as the **consumer-side affordance** for the maintainer's ruling A on objectstack#14149 (「同意」 2026-09-02): an `assignment` node value may now be a CEL value envelope `{ dialect: 'cel', source }` beside `{token}` interpolation — spec half landed in objectstack PR #15113 (merge `f3bbbef5`); the executor half is a `domain:services` card filed in objectstack alongside this one. `domain:*` is triage's to set (the fix lands in the published Studio flow form, so `domain:ui` is the seat's reading).

## Measured (by the #14149 dev, read-and-report; objectui `origin/main` at the time)

- `FlowKeyValueField` (`parseValue`, `:47-63`) already JSON-parses a `{…}` value cell into an object, so an envelope is STORABLE today through the key/value widget typed as JSON — but there is no affordance (no "expression" toggle, no dialect/source editor, no validation of the `value` role) and nothing tells an author the envelope form exists.
- `json-schema-to-fields` reads `xExpression` on string properties only; the spec's marker rides the map's `additionalProperties`, so the generic inspector does not surface it — nothing breaks, nothing appears.

## The ask

A Studio affordance on the `assignment` node's assignments editor: per value, choose "text (`{token}` interpolation)" or "expression (CEL)", storing the envelope `{ dialect: 'cel', source }` for the latter, with the spec's `AssignmentValueSchema` refusal surfaced inline (`ASSIGNMENT_VALUE_ENVELOPE_REFUSAL` — a malformed envelope) and the CEL stdlib reachable (`joinNonEmpty`, …). Keep `{token}` strings byte-identical.

## Unlock criterion

objectui consumes `@objectstack/spec` as a published package: this card is actionable once a spec release carrying `AssignmentValueSchema` / `LEDGER_DECLARED_NODE_CONFIG_SCHEMAS` (> 17.2.0) is installable here — not on the merge itself.
Restart-when: `pnpm view @objectstack/spec version` answers a version > 17.2.0 whose `dist` exports `AssignmentValueSchema` (probe: `node -e "console.log(typeof require('@objectstack/spec/automation').AssignmentValueSchema)"` in a fresh install prints `object`)
